content:
watchOS 27 is the next major software update for Apple Watch, and among its variety of new features, it will add two new apps to your Watch.

#1: Siri app

Siri is getting a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, and one part of that is a brand new Siri app.

The Siri app will be available across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and also the Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 will still let you invoke Siri via the Digital Crown, but the app is another place you can go to start a conversation. Perhaps more importantly, the app will let browse past ones.

Siri AI will be more conversational than ever, and also keep a record of past queries across all your devices. So the Siri app in watchOS 27 will show you conversations not just from your Apple Watch, but from your iPhone, Mac, and more.

You can find the full list of Apple Watch models compatible with Siri AI here.

#2: Find My app

Joining iOS 27’s new features for the Find My app, Apple has rethought the Find My experience in watchOS this year too.

In watchOS 26, Find My is currently split up into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple is streamlining all finding features into a new, unified Find My app.

Find My on Apple Watch provides all the functionality of the previous three apps, but in a condensed experience so you can easily locate anything or anyone on a map-centric view.

You can switch between different things you’re looking for via a menu in the top-left corner, but otherwise you’ll see a consistent interface.
